name: app.durely/garmin-insights-mcp
title: durely insights MCP for Garmin
description: Your full Garmin history, kept locally, analysed down to the second, via the official Personal API.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Garmin Personal API key. Leave empty if you saved it with `npx -y @durely/garmin-insights-mcp auth` (recommended): the server then reads it from ~/.config/garmin/connect-personal-api-key.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Your time zone, e.g. Europe/Brussels. Defaults to your computer's time zone.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_API_KEY_EXPIRES
environmentVariables.description: The date your key expires, e.g. 2027-10-24, so the server can warn you in time.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Your Garmin Personal API key file, mounted read-only.

key_file.description: Full path to the file that holds your key, e.g. /Users/you/.config/garmin/connect-personal-api-key.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Docker volume for the local cache of your Garmin history.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_MCP_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Your time zone, e.g. Europe/Brussels. The container doesn't know your computer's time zone, so set it.

environmentVariables.name: GARMIN_API_KEY_EXPIRES
environmentVariables.description: The date your key expires, e.g. 2027-10-24, so the server can warn you in time.
